title: Great intro to Barcelona!
text: We checked into our hotel at 9a and at 11 we were on our Tuk tuk! What a great way to see the city. Irene was the perfect guide. This is our first time visiting Barcelona and it was great to have an overall view of the city on our first day.
author: VERONICA_K

title: Great tour!
text: We really enjoyed this two hour tour. Irene our tour guide was very knowledgeable. She gave us history and architecture info. She offered to take our pictures at certain stops and even join in on a photo. Great tour if you don't care to do a great deal of walking.
author: Melanie_M
